decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory closely tied to the firm's existing trailer business, it is cheap to keep on offer while demand uncertainty is still resolving.

A box car trailer series fits the firm's core product range and homepage visibility suggests strategic importance, so the option value of staying in the market likely exceeds near-term carrying costs.
The car transporter trailer is more specialized and likely costlier to support, but after only one year the firm would usually keep it a bit longer unless clear negative evidence had emerged.
A low-bed trailer series is a credible extension of the firm's transport equipment offering, and its homepage presence indicates the firm is still backing it under uncertainty.
A high trailer cover series is a relatively low-risk add-on around the established trailer portfolio, making it worthwhile to retain while the market response becomes clearer.

Although it is in the core trailer category, having another box car trailer series increases overlap in the firm's option portfolio, which raises the chance of later rationalization but not yet enough to justify withdrawal.
